resources.string: Tell the subfeed server what you watch, subscribe to and keep in Watch Later, and take its queue order back. The first time, a full backup is written to Android/data/…/files before anything is sent.
Send what\'s waiting and fetch the server\'s queue order
Where the subfeed server is (default http://subfeed.wingert.internal)
subfeed: restore Watch Later from server snapshot
Replace Watch Later with the newest snapshot on the server (a backup of the current state is written first)
subfeed: restore Watch Later from local backup
Replace Watch Later with a backup file from Android/data/…/files (newest, or the first one from before subfeed)
